name: PulseCity scene assets
source: pulsecity-v2.3.html scene.js CityScene (seeds rng 7/3/11/31), exported at @3x; artwork unchanged
lookup: sets["<surface>/<theme>/<mood>"]  surfaces: hero | preview | full; themes: city | winter; moods: chill | social | nature | active | foodie | explore

surfaces.preview: Home City World preview card (v2.3 panel)
surfaces.full: Full-screen City World AND Surprise Me screen (v2.3 full, 390x844 pt)

requireNote: Use requirePath with a static require (Metro density family): require("./hero/hero_mid.png") resolves hero_mid@3x.png. Do not require the @Nx filename.
heroRule: Hero sets never contain metro, train or beams (checked).

responsiveScaling.rule: Lay each set out in its artboard (pt). Scale uniformly by k = max(viewW/artW, viewH/artH), anchor bottom-left, clip overflow. Apply k to every position, size and speed.
responsiveScaling.full: Full-screen artboard is 390x844 (iPhone 16e). Other aspect ratios crop sky (top) or the right edge after cover-scaling.

memory.note: decodedBytes = width*height*4 of each image once loaded. Mount only the active set; during a mood cross-fade two sets are mounted for 0.8 s.
memory.trim: Layers behind the opaque ground (preview/full) are cropped below the ground line: lossless.
